arguments.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one polished 2D cartoon game sprite. ONLY a gray SHARK DORSAL FIN projecting from a small white/pale-cyan foam strip, matching first exact source. Fin rises from low-left broad base to a swept high tip toward upper-right, then a deep concave rear edge drops to lower-right. Preserve shape and waterline occlusion. No shark head/body/eye/mouth/tail visible. Small separate curling white foam clump at lower-right as original. Second image ONLY supplies gray fin cel shading and white/light-cyan foam materials, not its sprawling body/splash shape. Sharp dark ink fin outline, restrained pale highlight. Water has NO dark shadow puddle. The exact FIRST image is geometry authority; redraw pixel stair-steps as smooth hand-inked curves without adding forms. True transparent alpha PNG, no background/scenery/text, no halo or outside glow, no cast shadow. Complete object must remain inside canvas with 5% clear transparent margin.
